packageRules.description: Keep the uv image version in .gitlab-ci.yml and the Dockerfile moving together. They are pinned to the same tag and digest on purpose, so that a local `task test` and a CI run use an identical toolchain; splitting them across two MRs would leave the two disagreeing in between.

hatchling is the build backend, pinned in build-system.requires. It is not installed at runtime and not part of the application's dependency surface, so it does not need to travel with the runtime dependency updates.
